findings.claim: ReportIfLocatedInCompilation drops every diagnostic whose location is not in a syntax tree of the current compilation. This is a blanket filter on the reportDiagnostic sink. Diagnostics created with a null or None location (e.g. from GetIdentifierLocation returning null for types without source) are silently suppressed. This includes error-level diagnostics such as MsgPack003/004/005, which are ledger-listed as Errors. Because this runs in the analyzer path, protections against insecure or unsupported configurations may be silently disabled. Only reportDiagnostic (analyzer) is wrapped, so the effect is limited to diagnostics, not to deserialization behavior. Ledger L8 says missing diagnostics for metadata types are not defects, so this is likely intended.

receipt_plan.detail: Run the existing analyzer tests (MsgPack003/004/005 etc.) plus a new test with a source-declared type whose diagnostic location is null or from a generated tree, and assert the diagnostic is still reported. Fails if any in-compilation diagnostic is dropped.
